sample: 样本 148 条（HN42 Lobsters12 Reddit48 IH20 PH26）| 日期 2026-09-24 | 未用 X 付费 API

ideas.title: Indie 分发地狱：188 封冷邮件只换 1 回复 + Reddit 禁自推 + 目录验证黑洞
ideas.target_users: 刚做出可用产品、卡在第一批付费用户的 solo/小团队；垂直 niche 且自然社区禁自推者

quotes.text: First-touch emails sent: 188… Human replies: still 1… Comments on other people's posts get same-day replies. Cold email doesn't
Reddit's self-promo rules are killing organic growth… ban self-promotion outright or restrict it to weekly share threads
trying to get one of my sites verified on a startup directory for months… still don't know why their check fails
building the product is now the easy part, and getting anyone to notice it is the real job

ideas.existing: Lemlist/Instantly, PhantomBuster, startup directories, Build-in-public social
ideas.defects: 冷邮优化发送量不解决交付物；Reddit 把受众与可获客拆开；目录验证无反馈；缺可回复 vs 仅学习分流
ideas.solution: Conversation-first 获客 OS：诊断结果→一屏交付物邮件；comment-only Reddit 策略；渠道按 clicks-per-post 排名
ideas.mvp: Web：产品一句话+ICP→10 条交付物冷邮+5 条零提及社区回答模板

ideas.title: 执行变便宜之后：错误决策也变便宜——要杀准则/刹车而不是更多生成
ideas.target_users: 用 Agent 周末出货的 indie；跳过验证步骤的人；需给 Agent 写 abstain 规则的平台方

quotes.text: we can now execute the wrong thing much faster too… AI can improve execution, but it doesn't automatically improve judgment
building a brake into the AI workflow… stop when it encounters an ambiguity
My listener found 289 invoicing complaints. I replied to zero… discovery isn't the scarce resource. Earned context is

ideas.existing: idea validator GPTs, interview tools, LangSmith evals, Jev/Milliseconds.ai
ideas.defects: 验证产品仍是更多生成；缺强制 kill criterion；Agent 默认填空继续；访谈矛盾被平滑
ideas.solution: Pre-execution Decision Gate：用户/痛点/30天证据/失败即停/不可逆面；歧义刹车清单
ideas.mvp: CLI/VS Code：无 kill criterion 则拒启动 agent session；导出决策日志

ideas.title: 催款与应收：上下文升级邮件要代码保证；听到痛点却不敢回复
ideas.target_users: 追逾期发票的自由职业者/小工作室；隐私优先记账开发者；需求发现者

quotes.text: It signed an email with a name I never gave it… An instruction is a preference and a check is a guarantee
templates were sometimes better than the model… Could you let me know either way - is it scheduled for payment
289 keyword hits… 0 where a reply from me wouldn't feel like a pitch

ideas.existing: FreshBooks/Wave reminders, Stripe dunning, AI follow-up SaaS
ideas.defects: 缺真实上下文阶梯；LLM 发明署名；监听停在关键词；云端劝退隐私用户
ideas.solution: 本地应收阶梯：结构化渲染身份/金额；模板为主模型为辅；回复资格四象限
ideas.mvp: 导入逾期发票→5 封阶梯稿+确定性校验（禁发明姓名）

ideas.title: Coding Agent Harness 锁定：要前端控制面可换底层
ideas.target_users: 同时试用多家 coding harness 的重度 agent 程序员

quotes.text: I wish we could use just the frontend of omp harness-agnostically… provider switching, stats dashboard, subscription pooling… with a swappable actual harness
ZCode is great. But as tied to GLM as CC is to Claude models… proprietary harness is just a little better

ideas.existing: Claude Code, OpenCode, ZCode, Continue/Cursor routing
ideas.defects: 优秀 UI 与真正 harness 绑死；换模型惩罚不透明；缺统一用量/成本视图
ideas.solution: Harness Control Plane：统一 provider/预算/会话；可插多家底层 harness
ideas.mvp: 本地 daemon+Web UI：对接 2 个 harness 会话列表与 token 用量

ideas.title: 站会时间线：要知道在 App 里做了啥，不要只知道开了哪个 App
ideas.target_users: 每日 scrum 复盘的工程师；介意云端屏幕捕获的隐私用户

quotes.text: Tired of trying to remember what you worked on yesterday for daily scrum… Typical time tracker just knows which app… this one knows what I worked on in the app… local one nothing leaves your device
I got tired of taking screenshots and explaining everything to AI agents

ideas.defects: 应用级统计无法合并跨工具任务；云端劝退；站会靠记忆/git log
ideas.solution: 本地 VLM 工作时间线→standup 三段；默认不出网
ideas.mvp: macOS 菜单栏本地采样→日终聚类任务→复制到 Slack 模板
